rules.sentence: A single study of 30 children found that the presence of an ultrasonographic effusion moderately increased the risk of septic arthritis (LR+ 8.4; 95% CI 4.1 to 17.1), while the absence of an ultrasonographic effusion moderately reduced the risk of septic arthritis (LR− 0.2; 95% CI 0.1 to 0.3).
